objects.name: Unmasking Cloud Identities: From Behavioral Clustering to Automated Detection
objects.description: We designed a behavioral clustering model to map cloud identity roles from audit logs, enabling continuous threat detection using standard SQL queries. The post Unmasking Cloud Identities: From Behavioral Clustering to Automated Detection appeared first on Unit 42 .
